oauthlogin-login-link: Label of the personal-tools link that starts the OAuth login.
oauthlogin-already-logged-in: Shown on Special:OAuthLogin when the visitor is already logged in.
oauthlogin-retry:
Shown under any error. Parameters:
* $1 - prefixed title of Special:OAuthLogin, used as a wikilink target.
oauthlogin-error-generic: Fallback error when the login fails for an unmapped reason.
oauthlogin-error-state: Error when the OAuth state parameter is missing, mismatched or older than ten minutes.
oauthlogin-error-denied: Error when the provider returns error=access_denied.
oauthlogin-error-provider: Error when the provider returns any other error code.
oauthlogin-error-domain: Error when the email domain is not in $wgOAuthLoginAllowedDomains or the email is not verified.
oauthlogin-error-token: Error when the token endpoint does not return an access token.
oauthlogin-error-userinfo: Error when the userinfo endpoint does not return JSON.
oauthlogin-error-noaccount: Error when no local account is bound to the provider identity and auto-creation is disabled or failed.
oauthlogin-error-blocked: Error when the resolved local account is sitewide blocked.
oauthlogin-missing-config: Shown when required configuration variables are empty.
